entries.summary: A share icon on the map, floating map and long-press sheet copies coordinates or shares a link to a location. It replaces the Share this location button.
Pick your game during first setup: Default, Pokémon Go or Pikmin Bloom. It only hides features you do not need. Change it any time in Settings > General > Game setup.
The accessibility helper is now called locationjoystick screen helper. After updating, turn it on again in Android Accessibility settings.
